title: Run a batch of GPU inference
description: Run the named model over the input batch on a GPU and deliver the outputs with an attestation of the hardware, model weights and inputs.

acceptance.rule: The attestation names the model weights SHA-256, the input hash and the output hash, and its signature verifies.
Validators re-run a sample of at least 5% of the inputs; each sampled output matches within the stated tolerance.
The result manifest lists one output for every input.
